tip.title: First, next, then, last
tip.text: Stories and instructions happen in order. Look for signal words like FIRST, NEXT, THEN, AFTER, and FINALLY. When you are asked what happened before or after something, go back to the text and check which sentence comes earlier.

passage.title: Making Champorado
passage.text:
It was a rainy Saturday. Lolo Ben said, "Let us make champorado."

First, Lolo washed one cup of sticky rice. Next, he put the rice in a pot with five cups of water. He turned on the stove and let it boil. Mia stirred the pot with a wooden spoon so the rice would not stick.

After ten minutes, Lolo added three pieces of tablea. The tablea melted and the rice turned brown. Then he added sugar. Mia tasted it. "More sugar, Lolo!" she said.

Finally, Lolo poured the champorado into two bowls and added a little milk on top. They ate it while the rain fell outside. Mia said it was the best breakfast ever.

words.meaning: mixed something by moving a spoon around in it
words.example: He stirred the soup so it would not burn.

words.meaning: changed from solid to liquid because of heat
words.example: The ice melted in the sun.

words.meaning: at the end; after everything else

items.why: The text says, "First, Lolo washed one cup of sticky rice."

items.prompt: What happened right AFTER Lolo added the tablea?
items.why: "The tablea melted and the rice turned brown" comes right after he added the tablea.

items.prompt: Put the steps in the correct order.
items.why: The signal words First, Next, After, Then, and Finally show this order.

items.prompt: How many pieces of tablea did Lolo add?
items.why: The text says, "Lolo added three pieces of tablea."

items.prompt: "The tablea melted and the rice turned brown." What does melted mean?
items.why: Tablea is a hard chocolate. In a hot pot it turns to liquid, which makes the rice brown.

items.prompt: Why did Mia stir the pot?
choices: So the rice would not stick
items.why: The story says she stirred "so the rice would not stick."
